newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank says board not meeting on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank says board not meeting on Thursday.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) board will not meet on Thursday, CNB spokesman Martin Svehla told Reuters.
"The board will not be meeting today," Svehla said. He did not elaborate. The CNB board usually holds regular meetings bi-weekly, and did not meet last week.
Svehla added that contrary to speculation from some local money market dealers, the CNB did not plan on making any moves with its last resort Lomabard lending facility.
"We will not be changing the Lombard rate today," he said.
Some dealers had said they expected the CNB to lower the Lombard rate from 50 percent to about 30 percent.

A wave of short-selling pressure from speculators in May forced the central bank to take a series of measures to shore up the currency, including raising the Lombard rate to 50 percent from 12.4 percent before the crisis began.
